newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine wheat harvest proceeds under the sun.
newsitem.headline: Argentine wheat harvest proceeds under the sun.

text.p: Argentina's wheat harvest was proceeding rapidly Monday in sunny hot weather, traders said.
The maize and soybean crops were developing well, with no urgent need for water, they told Reuters.
Over the weekend, there were storms in the north of central Buenos Aires province, a trader told Reuters.
Rising humidity could build up to rain in crop areas later Monday or on Tuesday, he said.

The Argentine government's Meteorological Service forecast hot, partially cloudy weather in key Buenos Aires province and in La Pampa. It said that temperatures should climb to 90 degrees Fahrenheit (32 degrees Celsius) in both Mar del Plata and Santa Rosa.
There was a possibility of storms and hot weather in Cordoba. Santa Fe skies should be partially cloudy and temperatures rise to 95 degrees Fahrenheit (35 degrees Celsius)
